name: Cart
effect: A simple two-wheeled vehicle drawn by a horse, mule, or ox, commonly used by farmers and merchants to transport goods over short distances.

name: Wagon
effect: A sturdy four-wheeled vehicle drawn by one or more draft animals, capable of carrying substantial cargo and passengers along the roads of the realm.

name: Carriage
effect: A covered four-wheeled passenger vehicle drawn by horses, fitted with enclosed seating and furnishings that offer greater comfort and protection from the elements.

name: Rowboat
effect: A small open wooden boat propelled by oars, suited to crossing rivers, navigating calm waterways, and carrying a handful of passengers or modest cargo.
